The 9-Hole course has been beautifully designed by graham cooke, a five time canadian amateur champion. Now a quebec based architect, cooke is known for his classic design philosophy mixed with a modern sensitivity for environmental concerns. Like a fine craftsman, he believes in attention to detail and a hands-On approach.

The course

The course offers three distinct and imaginative styles woven through the nine holes. The first three holes are planned as links-Styled golf, with large rolling greens embracing the look of famous courses like st. Andrews and the royal troon. The following four holes are dedicated to some of the world's best parkland courses - The first of which replicates augusta national's famed par three twelfth. And finally, the course finishes with two exceptional mediterranean-Syled holes. The orchard trees, water, sandy areas, rocky outcrops and clusters of colorful shrubs capture the character of courses such as valderrama in spain and pebble beach in california.
